brief_description: Verilator's stock examples/make_tracing_c output. Tiny FST (847 bytes) covering top, sub modules with mixed-width signals (2/40/70-bit), a 32-bit counter, and reset_l. Built locally with --trace-fst patched into the example Makefile. Exercises the tiny-trace edge of the parser plus Verilator's FST writer.
anchors: the file is ≤1 KB — a stress-test for FST headers with negligible body
